functions.name: LoadOrCreateSaveGameForLocalPlayer
functions.signature: LoadOrCreateSaveGameForLocalPlayer(Save Game Class, Local Player Controller, Slot Name)
functions.docs:
Synchronously loads a save game object in the specified slot for the local player, stalling the main thread until it completes.
This will return null for invalid parameters, but will create a new instance if the parameters are valid but loading fails.

functions.name: LoadOrCreateSaveGameForLocalPlayer
functions.signature: LoadOrCreateSaveGameForLocalPlayer(Save Game Class, Local Player, Slot Name)
functions.docs:
Native version of above function, this takes a ULocalPlayer because you can have a local player before a player controller.
This will return null for invalid parameters, but will create a new instance if the parameters are valid but loading fails.

functions.name: AsyncLoadOrCreateSaveGameForLocalPlayer
functions.signature: AsyncLoadOrCreateSaveGameForLocalPlayer(Save Game Class, Local Player Controller, Slot Name, Delegate)
functions.docs:
Asynchronously loads a save game object in the specified slot for the local player, if this returns true the delegate will get called later.
False means the load was never scheduled, otherwise it will create and initialize a new instance before calling the delegate if loading failed.

functions.name: AsyncLoadOrCreateSaveGameForLocalPlayer
functions.signature: AsyncLoadOrCreateSaveGameForLocalPlayer(Save Game Class, Local Player, Slot Name, Delegate)
functions.docs:
Native version of above function, this takes a ULocalPlayer and calls a native delegate.
False means the load was never scheduled, otherwise it will create and initialize a new instance before calling the delegate if loading failed.

functions.name: CreateNewSaveGameForLocalPlayer
functions.signature: CreateNewSaveGameForLocalPlayer(Save Game Class, Local Player, Slot Name)
functions.docs: Create a brand new save game, possibly ready for saving but without trying to load from disk. This will always succeed.

functions.name: SaveGameToSlotForLocalPlayer
functions.docs:
Synchronously save using the slot and user index, stalling the main thread until it completes.
This will return true if the save was requested, and errors should be handled by the HandlePostSave function that will be called immediately.

functions.name: AsyncSaveGameToSlotForLocalPlayer
functions.docs:
Asynchronously save to the slot and user index.
This will return true if the save was requested, and errors should be handled by the HandlePostSave function after the save succeeds or fails

functions.name: GetLocalPlayerController
functions.docs: Returns the local player controller this is associated with, this will be valid if it is ready to save

functions.name: GetLocalPlayer
functions.docs: Returns the local player this is associated with, this will be valid if it is ready to save

functions.name: SetLocalPlayer
functions.docs: Associates this save game with a local player, this is called automatically during load/create

functions.name: GetPlatformUserId
functions.docs: Returns the platform user to save to, based on Local Player by default

functions.name: GetPlatformUserIndex
functions.docs: Returns the user index to save to, based on Local Player by default

functions.name: GetSaveSlotName
functions.docs: Returns the save slot name to use

functions.name: SetSaveSlotName
functions.docs: Sets the save slot name for any future saves

functions.name: GetSavedDataVersion
functions.docs: Returns the game-specific version number this was last saved/loaded as

functions.name: GetInvalidDataVersion
functions.docs: Returns the invalid save data version, which means it has never been saved/loaded

functions.name: GetLatestDataVersion
functions.docs: Returns the latest save data version, this is used when the new data is saved

functions.name: WasLoaded
functions.docs: Returns true if this was loaded from an existing save

functions.name: IsSaveInProgress
functions.docs: Returns true if a save is in progress

functions.name: WasLastSaveSuccessful
functions.docs: Returns true if it has been saved at least once and the last save was successful

functions.name: WasSaveRequested
functions.docs: Returns true if a save was ever requested, may still be in progress

functions.name: InitializeSaveGame
functions.signature: InitializeSaveGame(Target, Local Player, In Slot Name, Was Loaded)
functions.docs: Initializes this save after either loading or initial creation, automatically called by load/create functions above

functions.name: ResetToDefault
functions.docs: Resets all saved data to default values, called when the load fails or manually

functions.name: OnResetToDefault
functions.docs: Blueprint event called to reset all saved data to default, called when the load fails or manually

functions.name: HandlePostLoad
functions.docs: Called after loading, this is not called for newly created saves

functions.name: OnPostLoad
functions.docs: Blueprint event called after loading, is not called for newly created saves

functions.name: HandlePreSave
functions.docs: Called before saving, do any game-specific fixup here

functions.name: OnPreSave
functions.docs: Blueprint event called before saving, do any game-specific fixup here

functions.name: HandlePostSave
functions.docs: Called after saving finishes with success/failure result

functions.name: OnPostSave
functions.docs: Blueprint event called after saving finishes with success/failure result

functions.name: ProcessSaveComplete
functions.signature: ProcessSaveComplete(Target, Slot Name, User Index, Success, Save Request)
functions.docs: Internal callback that will call HandlePostSave

functions.name: ProcessLoadedSave
functions.signature: ProcessLoadedSave(Base Save, Slot Name, User Index, Save Game Class, Local Player)
functions.docs: Internal helper function used by both the sync and async save
